items.t: A power cut. Phone torches only. {1} is delighted for exactly as long as the battery bank lasts.
Assembling flat pack furniture. The instructions are upside down and {3} has stopped consulting them.

alt.2: Assembling flat pack furniture. The instructions are upside down and {2} has stopped consulting them.
alt.1: Assembling flat pack furniture alone. The instructions are upside down and {1} stopped consulting them some time ago.

items.t: Somebody has brought back the wrong thing from the shop and is defending the decision.
All {N} of them staring at one small object on a table. Nobody is touching it.

alt.1: Staring at one small object on a table without touching it.
alt.2: Both of them staring at one small object on a table. Neither is touching it.

items.t: A wasp, and {N} completely different strategies, none of them working.

alt.1: A wasp. One strategy, committed to entirely, not working.

items.t: Trying to take a group photo with a timer. It has gone off four times.
A delivery driver at the door and nobody can find the thing they need to sign.
Waiting for a kettle that has been boiling for what feels like an hour.
Trying to get {4} into a carrier. {4} is winning on points.

alt.3: Trying to get {3} into a coat that {3} has decided against. {3} is winning on points.
alt.2: Trying to get {2} out of the door. {2} is winning on points.
alt.1: Trying to get something uncooperative into a carrier. It is winning on points.

items.t: A dropped plate, frozen mid shatter, {N} faces at {N} different stages of realising.

alt.1: A dropped plate, frozen mid shatter, and one face still a moment behind it.

items.t: Someone has fallen asleep in a chair and the others are quietly arranging things around them.

alt.1: Asleep in a chair, with the room quietly rearranged around them and no memory of it happening.

items.t: The wrong bus stop. Rain starting. Someone knew.
A supermarket self checkout has said something unexpected. The item is still in the bagging area.
Trying to fold a fitted sheet as a team.
Hanging a picture. One person holding, one person directing, one person disagreeing from the sofa.
A board game has reached the stage where someone has flipped it.
Unpacking a delivery that is much larger than anyone expected.
The smoke alarm. Nothing is on fire. Someone is on a chair with a tea towel.
Trying to leave the house. Fourth attempt. Keys located, phone lost.
Hair being cut in the kitchen with an audience of one and a half.
Carrying a sofa through a door it does not fit through. It is going to fit.
A surprise that has gone slightly wrong. Candles, dark room, somebody early.
Meeting a very large dog on a very narrow path.
Waiting room. Bad chairs, and {N} ways of sitting in them wrong.

alt.1: Waiting room. Bad chairs. One person sitting in one of them wrong.

items.t: Beach in the wrong weather. Coats over swimwear. Refusing to go home.
A queue that has not moved. {2} has quietly found a better one.

alt.1: A queue that has not moved. {1} has quietly spotted a better one and is deciding.

items.t: Teaching someone a card game whose rules are being invented in real time.
Painting a wall. More paint on people than wall.
The exact moment a chair leg gives way.
Rescuing something from a high shelf using a broom and a plan.
A very long escalator. Two of them are fine about it.

alt.1: A very long escalator. {1} is fine about it, or is pretending to be.

items.t: Cooking one meal with {N} chefs and one hob.

alt.1: Cooking one meal on one hob, with every pan in the house already out.

items.t: Waking someone gently. It has not gone gently.
